proposed_record.reviewerRationale: Coverage value: Sandbox Centre adds Barrie's Ontario Regional Innovation Centre, its selective founder-support pathway, mobility-commercialization role and bounded defence-entry programming. Evidence: Thirteen durable first-party, Ontario, federal, municipal and regional sources anchor identity, legal name, services, public contact, program participation, funding disclosure and current activity. Mission/Public Need read: No Mission Area or Public Need match is proposed because Sandbox supports ventures and ecosystem navigation rather than offering a technical capability. Unknowns: Current incorporation and board structure, consistent postal code, the precise basis of Ontario's disclosed payment, and verified defence-program outcomes remain unresolved. Reviewer action: Confirm the legal and location boundaries, then assess the two cited program participations, defence limits and public-payment qualification before accepting this amber organization candidate.
